verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.synctera.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of per-version LLM bundles (v2 at 668 pages, v0 at 529 pages). Those bundles are actually served, for example _llms/v2.md and _llms/v2/learning-center.md, and individual guides are available as .md pages, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. A machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how agents should use llms.txt, and independent corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice.
